label: Вообще
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вообще (in general, at all) covering generalisation, emphasis, and negation.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Reinforcing negation. 'Вообще' here means 'at all' and strengthens 'не люблю', making the dislike total. With negation it intensifies the denial.
Strategic focus: Discourse opener. As a sentence opener 'вообще' means 'generally' or 'actually', framing a personal view. It softly introduces an opinion.
Strategic focus: Total negation. 'Вообще' reinforces 'ничего не сказал', meaning he said absolutely nothing. It piles emphasis onto the negative.
Strategic focus: Set discourse phrase. 'Вообще говоря' is a fixed expression meaning 'generally speaking', introducing a measured judgement. It frames the statement as a broad truth.
Strategic focus: Emotional emphasis. Here 'вообще' adds irritation to the question, meaning roughly 'are you even listening?'. It heightens the speaker's frustration.
Strategic focus: General assessment. 'Вообще' means 'in general' and frames the following evaluation as broadly true. It opens a summarising remark.
Strategic focus: Total lapse. 'Вообще' intensifies 'забыл', meaning the meeting slipped the mind completely. It stresses the totality of forgetting.
Strategic focus: Absolute absence. 'Вообще' reinforces 'нет людей', meaning there is nobody at all. It makes the emptiness complete.
Strategic focus: Generalising judgement. 'Вообще' means 'in general' and frames 'странный' as an overall trait. It widens the description to his whole character.
Strategic focus: Emphatic distinction. 'Вообще' intensifies 'другая', meaning 'a completely different story'. The fixed phrase sets the topic firmly apart.
